dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: Well, that's the focus of my work.

dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: As you know, people who live in different regions have different habits when taking measurements.

dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: The people in the eastern part of the city say that a length of rope is a quarter-meter long, and people in the west will ask "and how much is that, exactly?"

dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: My job is to match these things that don't fit together and come up with a common name for them, for example, "Mermonia Meters," or something of the order.

dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: That was just an example, by the way. Please don't take it too seriously.
